themes.title: Trump‑Russia Diesel Deal Fallout
themes.blurb: President Trump's agreement to purchase Russian diesel fuel despite energy sanctions has ignited fierce condemnation from Ukraine and drawn intense media focus across transatlantic outlets. Right-wing and mainstream commentary in both the US and France are tracking the geopolitical blowback as Kyiv accuses Washington of undermining its war effort.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Coverage highlights Trump defending the energy deal to lower domestic fuel prices while dismissing Ukrainian criticism.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: French outlets analyze the diplomatic fallout and strain on European-American alliance unity following the deal.

themes.title: Scandinavian Far‑Right Youth Surge
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Scandinavia are navigating major political shifts focused on younger voters. While Norway's Progress Party (FrP) reaches historic polling highs propelled by massive support under age 30, Sweden Democrats (SD) leadership is debating missteps that caused a drop in youth backing.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP becomes Norway's largest party overall at 33.2%, commanding an extraordinary 53% support among voters under 30.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD leaders conduct internal debate after key proposals alienated young voters and dented electoral prospects.

themes.title: US Sanctions and Pressure on International Institutions
themes.blurb: The Trump administration's aggressive measures against global judicial bodies—specifically targeting the International Criminal Court (ICC) and criticizing international reports—are triggering debate across borders. Outlets in both the US and France are following the White House's confrontation with international consensus.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Administration sanctions the ICC over arrest warrants and publicly attacks UN-related peace prize recognitions.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: French media details US ultimatums issued to ICC member states regarding enforcement and cooperation.
